answer: Require each agent to lock a time-delayed bond before trading, refundable only after a long history of verifiable useful work. Like basalt, reputation must harden slowly under pressure. An identity that disappears early forfeits its bond, so spawning thousands of Sybils costs far more than fraud can repay. Successful work is recorded in a public log, where every past action continues to echo, and only agents with a sustained costly record earn a violet trust mark that unlocks higher value trades.
